rebuild_intent.summary: A two-story residential building with a gable roof. The structure features wood plank walls on both floors with alternating stonebrick bands between levels. Multiple glass windows are distributed across both floors. The building sits on a stonebrick foundation and is surrounded by a dirt courtyard.
